convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iMA indicators with standard parameters. Simple divergence-based entry/exit rules. Fixed lot sizing. Trade management via standard Trade.mqh library classes (CTrade, CSymbolInfo, etc.) which are well-understood wrappers around MQL5 API calls. No custom indicators, no multi-timeframe logic, no hedging, no grid, no martingale.

derived_values.name: MA divergence previous bar (implicit in dv2)

other_exits: BreakEven function: moves SL to breakeven (open price) when price is BreakEven points in profit. Disabled when BreakEven=0.
BasketProfitON: closes ALL account positions when account profit >= BasketProfit. Disabled by default.
BasketLossON: closes ALL account positions when account profit <= -BasketLoss. Disabled by default.
Trailing stop: moves SL to follow price at Trailing pips distance once position is in profit past entry. Disabled when Trailing=0.

position_sizing.conditional_logic: When MultyOpen=true, additional volume can be added to existing position up to MaxVolume (0.5 lots). Only same-direction adds allowed. Volume check: NormalizeDouble(Pos.Volume()+lot,2)<=MaxVolume.

custom_logic_notes: The Divergence function simplifies to (maF2[0]-maS2[0]), which is the previous bar's MA spread. Entry requires divergence to be within a band: for Buy, Divergence must be between DVBuySell (0.0011) and DVStayOut (0.0079); for Sell, between -DVStayOut (-0.0079) and -DVBuySell (-0.0011). This means the EA enters when the slow MA spread from the previous bar is moderately positive (buy) or moderately negative (sell), but not extreme. SignalCloseBuy and SignalCloseSell always return false, so positions are only closed by SL/TP/trailing/breakeven/basket logic, never by signal reversal. Position gate allows entry only when no position exists (unless MultyOpen is enabled, in which case same-direction add-up to MaxVolume is permitted). SL/TP are in raw points (not pips), calculated as Sym.Point()*StopLossPoints, so 550 points = 55 pips on 5-digit or 550 pips on 4-digit. No digit adjustment is performed.
python_conversion_notes: Standard SMA indicators from any library (TA-Lib, pandas_ta, etc.). Divergence logic is straightforward: compute fast SMA - slow SMA for current and previous bar, then derive signal. The position gate logic (no_position with optional MultyOpen add-up) needs explicit state tracking. BreakEven and TrailingStop functions operate on every tick and need per-tick position monitoring. Basket profit/loss close is account-level (close all positions across all symbols). The Trade.mqh classes map to standard broker API calls in Python (ccxt, etc.). Deviation is set to Sym.Spread()*3 for slippage tolerance. SL/TP price validation checks against StopsLevel before placing orders. Note: Trade.Buy/Sell called with price=0 which means market price in MQL5.
